category_title: Students in vocational settings who struggle with professional norms like punctuality
minimal_context: The student is arriving late to their long-day vocational program at the TAFE college and needs to complete the daily sign-in routine.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is past 8:30am. I also noticed you didn't sign off yesterday when you left.

STUDENT: Yeah, I forgot to sign off.

TUTOR: Please try to remember next time. Why are you arriving late this morning?

STUDENT: I couldn't get here on time today. I'm just really tired.

TUTOR: You still need to make sure you get here when the program starts.

STUDENT: I'm tired from moving house, I couldn't help being late.

options.A: Gradually fade youth worker support and transfer responsibility to the student during the program.
options.B: Ensure classroom routines such as signing in and out each day mimic workplace practices.
options.C: Provide instruction in math, reading, and science using a modified curriculum during the program.
options.D: Promote cooperative learning among students during the vocational program rather than preventing it.
